exposure: LOXL1 knockout status (LOXL1 KO vs. WT)
cohort: Female LOXL1 knockout (KO) mice, which develop pelvic organ prolapse, and wild-type (WT) mice, observed during pregnancy, after vaginal or cesarean delivery, and as unmanipulated controls.
finding: LOXL1 KO mice exhibit significantly up-regulated CXCL12 and CCL7 mRNA in pelvic organs during pregnancy compared to WT mice, and this dysregulation persists after vaginal delivery, with CCL7 showing faster and greater increases in LOXL1 KO mice.
mod_finding: The study found that differences in cytokine expression between LOXL1 KO and WT mice during pregnancy persisted after vaginal delivery, with CCL7 gene expression and serum levels increasing faster and to a greater extent in LOXL1 KO mice after vaginal delivery.
